bricks.label: struct Node
bricks.plain_english: Defines what a node looks like. Every node stores a value and a pointer to the next node. This is the blueprint — without it, nothing else can exist.
bricks.scene_description: A single grey sphere appears in the centre of the scene.

bricks.label: createNode()
bricks.plain_english: Allocates memory for a new node and sets its value. Returns a pointer to it. Think of it as the factory that makes nodes — insertHead() will call this every time it needs a new one.
bricks.scene_description: A value label appears on the sphere. The NULL terminator dot appears to its right.

bricks.label: insertHead()
bricks.plain_english: Creates a new node and places it at the beginning of the list. Updates the head pointer to the new node.

bricks.label: insertTail()
bricks.plain_english: Walks the entire list to find the last node, then appends a new one at the end.

bricks.label: insertAt()
bricks.plain_english: Inserts a node at a specific index. Rewires two pointers — the node before points to the new one, the new one points to the next.

bricks.label: deleteHead()
bricks.plain_english: Removes the first node. Moves the head pointer to the second node. Frees the removed node.
bricks.scene_description: First sphere fades out. Head arrow jumps to the next node.

bricks.label: deleteNode()
bricks.plain_english: Finds a node by value, patches the gap by rewiring the previous node's next pointer. Frees the found node.

bricks.label: traverse()
bricks.plain_english: Walks from head to NULL, visiting each node. The most fundamental operation — search and display both rely on this.
bricks.scene_description: A glowing packet travels along the arrows from head to NULL.

bricks.label: freeList()
bricks.plain_english: Deallocates every node in the list. Walks from head to NULL, freeing each one.
bricks.scene_description: All spheres fade out sequentially from head to tail.
